description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardPopText' that manages pop-up text behavior in an Android soft keyboard, including preferences for when to show pop-up text (on correction, on word, on key press), and methods for displaying and reverting pop-up text overlays.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPopText
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'AnySoftKeyboardPowerSaving' that handles pop-up text display logic in the keyboard, including preferences, pop-up rendering, and reversion.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the class and subscribes to preference changes for pop text options.

methods.name: updatePopTextPrefs
methods.description: Updates internal flags based on the selected pop text option, enabling pop-up on correction, word, or key press.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Overrides suggestion picking to prevent pop-up text when user manually selects a suggestion.

methods.name: popText
methods.description: Displays a pop-up text overlay at the position of the last pressed key.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key press events, triggering pop-up text if configured for key press.

methods.name: commitWordToInput
methods.description: Commits a word to input and optionally triggers a pop-up if the word differs from the typed word.

methods.name: revertLastWord
methods.description: Reverts the last typed word and also reverts the last pop-up text if any.

methods.name: revertLastPopText
methods.description: Reverts the last pop-up text overlay if it exists and is not yet dismissed.
